extraMeanings.en: to have authority over someone or a group
extraMeanings.exampleEn: General Lee commanded an army of thousands of soldiers.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: General Lee binlerce askerden oluşan bir orduya kumanda etti.

extraMeanings.en: good knowledge or control of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She has an excellent command of three languages.

extraMeanings.en: to express an opinion about something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The minister refused to comment on the rumours.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bakan söylentiler hakkında yorum yapmayı reddetti.

extraMeanings.en: an advertisement on television or radio
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The movie was interrupted by a long commercial.

extraMeanings.en: to make something else seem better by combining well with it
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The wine perfectly complements the cheese.

extraMeanings.en: a group of buildings or a large structure
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They built a huge shopping complex outside the city.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şehrin dışında devasa bir alışveriş kompleksi inşa ettiler.

extraMeanings.en: an emotional problem causing anxiety about something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He has a complex about his height.

extraMeanings.en: to praise or express admiration for someone
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She complimented me on my cooking.

extraMeanings.en: to make yourself calm after being upset
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She took a moment to compose herself before speaking.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Konuşmadan önce kendini toparlamak için bir an durdu.

extraMeanings.en: a piece of music that someone has written
extraMeanings.exampleEn: This is one of Mozart's finest compositions.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu, Mozart'ın en güzel bestelerinden biridir.

extraMeanings.en: to organize and carry out an activity
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The scientists conducted an experiment in the lab.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları laboratuvarda bir deney gerçekleştirdi.

extraMeanings.en: to direct the performance of musicians
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She conducted the orchestra with great energy.

extraMeanings.en: a secret or the state of trusting someone with private information
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I told her the news in confidence.

extraMeanings.en: to be in disagreement or be incompatible
extraMeanings.exampleEn: His account of events conflicts with hers.

extraMeanings.en: deliberately low or cautious (of an estimate)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: At a conservative estimate, the trip will cost $2000.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İhtiyatlı bir tahminle, gezi 2000 dolara mal olacak.

extraMeanings.en: kindness and thought for other people's feelings
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He showed great consideration for the elderly passengers.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı yolculara büyük bir anlayış gösterdi.

extraMeanings.en: to become smaller or shorter
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Metal contracts as it cools.

extraMeanings.en: to catch or develop an illness
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He contracted malaria while travelling abroad.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yurt dışında seyahat ederken sıtmaya yakalandı.

extraMeanings.en: the opposite of what has been said
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I'm not tired; on the contrary, I feel great.

extraMeanings.en: to say numbers in order or find a total
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The child can count to twenty.

extraMeanings.en: to be important or to be included
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Every vote counts in this election.

extraMeanings.en: a boat, ship, or aircraft
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Several small craft were sailing on the lake.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gölde birkaç küçük tekne yol alıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to suddenly stop working (of a computer or system)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My laptop crashed and I lost all my work.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dizüstü bilgisayarım çöktü ve tüm çalışmamı kaybettim.

extraMeanings.en: to hit something violently while moving
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The car crashed into a tree.

extraMeanings.en: praise or recognition for something good
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She deserves credit for solving the problem.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sorunu çözdüğü için takdiri hak ediyor.

extraMeanings.en: the list of people who worked on a film or show
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We stayed until the credits rolled at the end of the movie.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Filmin sonunda jenerik akana kadar oturduk.

extraMeanings.en: extremely serious or dangerous
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The patient is in a critical condition after the accident.

extraMeanings.en: to cut off the edges of a picture, or cut short
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I cropped the photo to remove the background.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Arka planı kaldırmak için fotoğrafı kırptım.

extraMeanings.en: to make the loud cry of a cockerel
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The rooster crowed at dawn.

extraMeanings.en: to press something so hard it breaks or loses shape
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She crushed the garlic with a knife.

extraMeanings.en: to make an illness or a sick person healthy again
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The new drug can cure the disease completely.

extraMeanings.en: to bend or move in a curved line
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The road curves sharply to the left.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yol keskin bir şekilde sola kıvrılıyor.

extraMeanings.en: to reduce the bad effect of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Savings can cushion the impact of losing a job.

extraMeanings.en: to divide or wound something using a sharp tool
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She cut the cake into eight pieces.

extraMeanings.en: to reduce an amount or level
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The company decided to cut prices by ten percent.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şirket fiyatları yüzde on düşürmeye karar verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to ride a bicycle
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I cycle to work every morning.

extraMeanings.en: to harm or spoil something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The storm damaged several houses.

extraMeanings.tr: meydan okumak, kışkırtmak (birini bir şey yapmaya) (fiil)
extraMeanings.en: to challenge someone to do something risky
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My friends dared me to jump into the cold lake.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşlarım soğuk göle atlamam için bana meydan okudu.

extraMeanings.en: to blind briefly with bright light, or to impress greatly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The bright headlights dazzled the driver.

extraMeanings.en: unwilling to listen or pay attention to something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He was deaf to all our warnings.

extraMeanings.en: to discuss a subject formally, or consider carefully
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The parliament debated the new law for hours.
